text: Implemented executable JVM asset loading with typed native direction, RAS/LPS/FSL conventions, dense encoding, content fingerprints, and lossless normalization provenance. Built-ins cover ANTs ITK affines/displacement NIfTI, FSL FLIRT/dense FNIRT-style fields, and AFNI affine/warp fields; HDF5 composites fail with an explicit adapter requirement. Affine normalization and inversion use Gale DMat/LU, with one explicit bridge into image geometry DMat. Independent fixtures verify all three affine conventions and a real LPS displacement NIfTI through the fused operator; dense inverse claims require an executable inverse asset. git diff --check clean; focused JVM 8/8; full spatial JVM/JS pass (101/101 and 87/87).
